baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative joins the focus noun for favors, the dual possessive 'your Lord,' and a dual verb of declaring false.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowed benefits are assigned to an owning, nurturing Lord and placed before both addressees for an explicit truth verdict.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the objects being enumerated and tested by the question.
Lordship, ownership, and authority assign the favors to the sovereign who poses the challenge.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord's relation an ongoing provision rather than bare possession.
Declaring a thing or its giver false turns the dual response into an overt verdict.

changed_reading.before: A generic rhetorical reminder to be grateful.
changed_reading.after: A dual evidentiary challenge: identify which bestowed provisions of your nurturing sovereign you can actually declare false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus words admit oath, following liability, pact, and a charge that proves true only when carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can function as a covenantal summons: benefits bind their recipients, and denial appears as failure to perform the answering obligation.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making gives the focus noun a covenantal undertone without replacing its favor sense.
A liability that follows its holder supplies the continuing obligation generated by receipt.
A binding pact under Lordship frames giver and recipients as parties to an enduring relation.
A charge that proves true by being carried through makes denial behavioral as well as verbal.

changed_reading.before: Denying favors means uttering a false proposition about them.
changed_reading.after: Which favor-bound obligations from your Lord will the two of you fail to make true in performance?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual possessive and dual verb address a pair, while the split mapping of the focus noun offers following sequence and one voice answering another.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative solicits two successive responses, so truth or denial is exposed through a paired vocal exchange rather than a solitary judgment.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence makes the pair's answers temporally ordered.
A voice following a voice supplies an antiphonal shape for the dual address.
Declaring false gives each answering voice a consequential verdict.

changed_reading.before: One rhetorical question happens to use dual grammar.
changed_reading.after: A call is issued to a pair whose successive voices disclose whether they ratify or deny the Lord's favors.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching discloses, expression makes meaning evident, reckoning counts, balance measures, and marks permit recognition; together they turn the focus question into a test conducted against legible evidence.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something false supplies the verdict whose evidentiary basis is being tested.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the capacity by which a favor can become known.
Revealing meaning through speech or sign makes the evidence communicable.
Counting and calculation turn diffuse signs into an accountable reckoning.
Measuring by weight supplies a standard against which a verdict can be checked.
Recognition by an effect or mark shows that inner status can become publicly legible.
A visible distinguishing mark materializes the evidence that recognition reads.

structural_cues: 55:2-9 moves from teaching and expression to calculation and just measure.
55:41 later depicts judgment without interrogation because marks already disclose identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, signs, counting, measure, and recognition; I infer that these form an epistemic procedure culminating in the focus verdict. A live alternative is that they are separate demonstrations with no procedural sequence.

changed_reading.before: The refrain asks for an affective admission of gratitude.
changed_reading.after: The refrain asks which evidence-bearing favors fail the pair's count, measure, or recognition strongly enough to warrant a false verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prohibition of excess and the just balance establish productive limits; fear of the Lord's standing then precedes two gardens, allowing restraint itself to enter the inventory of favors.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors provide the category widened here to include formative restraint.
Nurturing and completing make a corrective limit capable of functioning as care.
Crossing the limit in rebellion identifies the excess that restraint blocks.
The balance of justice gives the limit a constructive and ordered form.
A diminution that takes from a thing supplies fear's pruning image: excess is reduced rather than the person merely terrified.
Standing or station fixes accountability as a position one must inhabit.
The tree-covered garden is the flourishing outcome placed after fear and standing.

structural_cues: 55:46 grammatically conditions the two gardens on fearing the Lord's standing.
The focus comes after the garden's branches and running springs, so restraint and abundance remain in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excess, just measure, fear, standing, and gardens; I infer a pruning arrow in which reverent restraint enables ordered flourishing. A live alternative is that fear is only a qualifying response, not a causal form of favor.

changed_reading.before: A favor is an immediately pleasant object such as a garden or spring.
changed_reading.after: Some favors arrive as limits and reverent diminutions that cut back excess so a balanced life can flower.

context_deltas.mechanism: Just measure and action answered by corresponding action externalize the focus-only oath, pact, liability, and fulfilled-charge model as a reciprocal economy of benefaction.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making supplies the binding register of the reciprocal relation.
A right or liability following its holder makes received favor carry a continuing answerability.
A covenant or protection pact gives Lordship a relational bond rather than an isolated title.
A charge succeeds only when carried through, translating truth into performance.
The balance of justice supplies the covenant's norm of non-defective exchange.
Equity and fairness specify how the pair's answering conduct must be measured.
An action met by its recompense makes reciprocity explicit.
Good action repeated on both sides names benefaction as the currency of response.

structural_cues: The early imperative establishes fair measure, while 55:60 repeats benefaction on both sides of a second interrogative.
The recurrent dual refrain repeatedly returns both recipients to the same reciprocal question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies balance, fairness, recompense, and mirrored benefaction; I infer that these instantiate the focus branches as a covenant ledger. A live alternative is a looser moral analogy without a covenantal bond.

changed_reading.before: The pair need only concede that favors exist.
changed_reading.after: The pair are asked which terms of reciprocal benefaction they will falsify by failing to answer gift with just, good action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two bodies meet across a maintained middle without transgression, and fruits later appear as joined counterparts; the focus dual therefore addresses a coupled pair whose unity does not erase distinction.

activation_trace.role: One Lord's authority holds the two addressees in a common field of accountability.
The dual declaration requires a shared verdict from still-distinct agents.
Two opposed things meeting supplies contact without prior sameness.
The middle between two things preserves a real interval inside their relation.
A connection standing between endpoints makes the interval relational rather than merely divisive.
Transgressing a boundary by aggression names the collapse that the paired order prevents.
A counterpart joined to its mate repeats the structure of relation-with-distinction beside the focus.

structural_cues: Dual seas meet in 55:19-20, while dual gardens, springs, and fruit pairs surround 55:51.
The focus itself marks both possession and response as dual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting, a maintained middle, non-transgression, and paired counterparts; I infer that the physical pattern models the two addressees' joint but non-collapsed answer. A live alternative is that the dual images are abundance markers only.

changed_reading.before: The dual simply aggregates two audiences into one rhetorical target.
changed_reading.after: The question asks two coupled but irreducible witnesses to answer together without one voice erasing or trespassing upon the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between cessation and abiding, followed by flowing and gushing sources, activates focus branches of falling short and failing expected duration; denial becomes a judgment that provision will not hold.

activation_trace.role: Falling short or lagging supplies the alleged deficiency being tested.
Staying and lasting make the Lord's provision the stable side of the duration contrast.
Milk disappearing instead of lasting supplies a concrete image of provision failing expectation.
Cessation and disappearance after persistence establish the transient pole.
Continuance and abiding establish the answering durable pole.
Continuing sustenance or grant makes the immediately preceding flow a promise of provision over time.
Water welling abundantly reinforces replenishment rather than a one-time allotment.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 places universal passing away against the Lord's abiding presence.
The focus immediately follows two running springs and is later echoed after two gushing springs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transience, abiding, continuous grant, and abundant upwelling; I infer that the unusual failure-to-last branch of the focus verb tests trust in provision's continuance. A live alternative is ordinary propositional denial with no duration component.

changed_reading.before: To deny is simply to call a present gift untrue.
changed_reading.after: The pair are challenged over which streams of their abiding Lord they judge to have failed, fallen short, or not lasted as provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branching canopy, water sources, continuing flow, edible fruit, and paired propagation form a regenerative system; the focus asks about the whole provisioning process, not a heap of unrelated amenities.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors name the system's outputs as gifts.
Repair, nurture, and stagewise completion organize the separate garden details as one maintained process.
The non-dominant mapping's nourishment and growth sharpen Lordship into temporal cultivation.
Extending, ramifying branches supply the productive architecture of the gardens.
A source of running water supplies the regenerative input.
Continuing sustenance turns water movement into maintained provisioning.
Edible fruit is the system's enjoyable yield.
A counterpart joined to its mate makes the yield paired and reproductively complete.

structural_cues: 55:51 is placed between running water in 55:50 and every fruit in pairs in 55:52.
Dual gardens, branches, springs, and fruit pairs repeat a productive architecture rather than an unstructured list.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branches, source water, ongoing flow, fruit, and pairs; I supply the causal arrow water-to-growth-to-yield and read Lordship as maintaining it. A live alternative is a non-causal catalogue of delights.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's favors are discrete pleasurable objects to count one by one.
changed_reading.after: The favor under challenge is a self-renewing ecology in which source, flow, branching, and paired yield continuously generate one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Identical refrains immediately before and after the focus make it one station in a following sequence, while the split-root voice image makes the repeated station available as call-and-response.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors keep the repeated call anchored in its ordinary object.
A voice following another voice makes the preceding identical refrain an antiphonal cue.
Following in sequence makes the next identical refrain continue the challenge instead of restarting it.

structural_cues: The exact focus wording occurs at 55:49 and 55:53, with one descriptive ayah between each recurrence.
The possessive and response remain dual at every recurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact flanking repetitions plus branches of sequence and answering voice; I infer a performed antiphon in which each gift-description prompts another answer. A live alternative is a literary refrain with no enacted vocal exchange.

changed_reading.before: 55:51 is a self-contained rhetorical question interrupting a description.
changed_reading.after: 55:51 is a beat in a serial call-and-response whose repeated answers accumulate, revise, and expose the pair's stance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two running springs immediately before the focus are literally water sources but also branch into eyes and acts of seeing; the dual question can therefore stage provision itself as paired visible witness.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false supplies the verdict challenged by what is visibly present.
A spring as a source of flowing water keeps the local image materially literal.
Seeing with the eye converts the same dual source image into an evidentiary witness.
Visible flowing and spreading make the witness active rather than static.

structural_cues: 55:50 has a dual noun and dual verb, followed immediately by the focus's dual possessive and dual verb.
The source noun's branch inventory holds both spring and eye without requiring a new root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two flowing springs and eye/seeing branches; I infer a binocular witness in which what provides also testifies. A live alternative is to keep only the literal spring sense and treat the eye activation as wordplay.

changed_reading.before: The springs are objects later named as blessings by an external question.
changed_reading.after: The paired sources become quasi-eyes: provision stands before the two recipients as visible testimony against their attempt to declare it false.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary focus branch explicitly names favors while the activated branch is a plant homonym; it remains anchored in the exact focus root and is made materially live by nearby branches and fruit. Carry it only as a counterimage for mixed gift-experience, not as a replacement translation of the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 2 occurs amid garden branches, flowing water, and fruit.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors preserve the primary semantic anchor that the counterimage qualifies.
The attractive yet bitter ala shrub supplies a sensory mismatch between appearance and taste.
Ramifying garden branches give the shrub image a local botanical surface.
Pleasant fruit supplies the taste domain against which bitterness becomes diagnostic.

changed_reading.before: A true favor must look and taste immediately pleasant.
changed_reading.after: The garden sequence permits a contained counterimage: a gift may look beautiful yet taste bitter, so felt bitterness alone does not make the gift false.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus verb's cloth branch is idiomatic and form-distant, not the direct syntax of the ayah; it remains anchored in that exact verb and is activated by explicit linings, furnishings, and precious patterned textiles. Render it only as a material analogy for deceptive appearance, never as the lexical translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denial verb at word 4 is followed in the same garden sequence by inner linings and later patterned furnishings.

activation_trace.role: A variegated cloth that deceives by its condition makes falsehood a mismatch between displayed surface and actual state.
A garment's inner lining supplies the hidden layer against which a surface can be tested.
Spread furnishings keep the analogy inside the packet's material scene.
Precious patterned rugs intensify the visible textile surface whose truthfulness is at issue.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a proposition spoken about a favor.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be pictured materially as a brilliant surface that advertises one condition while its inner lining or actual state tells another.

strongest_changes: The focus became an evidentiary verdict grounded in teaching, signs, reckoning, measure, and recognition rather than a bare gratitude prompt.
Its local garden details became a regenerative causal system: source, flow, branching, and paired yield under ongoing nurture.
Dual grammar became structurally active through paired boundaries, paired witnesses, and a serial antiphonal response.
Denial retained coexisting behavioral and temporal readings: failing a reciprocal charge and judging provision not to last.
Restraint and fear remained live as formative favors that prevent excess and enable flourishing.
summary.what_was_special: The exact focus sits between two running sources and paired fruit while identical refrains flank it; this activated non-dominant following/growth mappings, reciprocal performance, and contained material outliers without collapsing them into the ordinary favor-denial reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The antiphonal reading depends on treating the non-dominant following/voice mapping as activation rather than lexical substitution.
The causal arrows from restraint to flourishing and from water to the complete garden system are reader-supplied, though packet order strongly supports them.
The duration, botanical, binocular, and textile readings should remain explicitly exploratory because their branch images are more distant than ordinary denial.
